position_overview: Summary: The Electrical Technician plays a critical role in ensuring the reliable operation, safe installation, and efficient maintenance of industrial electrical systems and machinery at client sites. This position requires a technically proficient professional with hands-on experience in electrical maintenance, troubleshooting, and equipment commissioning. The ideal candidate will contribute to operational excellence by delivering high-quality technical service, maintaining strict safety standards, and building strong client relationships through responsive support and clear communication. The role is essential to minimizing downtime, enhancing system performance, and supporting the continued growth of the technical service team.
